spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval), AVG("HR_BPM") AS "HR" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) LIMIT 144000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_at,$__interval), AVG("HEART_RATE") AS "HRX" FROM "XIAOMI_ACTIVITY_SAMPLE" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_at, $__interval) LIMIT 144000

SELECT timestamp_at, 0::float AS "spacer"
FROM "XIAOMI_ACTIVITY_SAMPLE"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_at)
LIMIT 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval), AVG("PNN50") AS "PNN50", AVG("RMSSD_MS") AS "RMSSD", AVG("SDNN_MS") AS "SDNN" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) LIMIT 144000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval), AVG("CPC_LFC_RATIO") AS "CPC", AVG("HF_PEAK_STABILITY") AS "HF Peak" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) LIMIT 144000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_at,$__interval), AVG("RR_MILLIS") AS "RR", MAX("RR_MILLIS") AS "Max", MIN("RR_MILLIS") AS "Min" FROM "HEART_RR_INTERVAL_SAMPLE" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_at, $__interval) LIMIT 2000

WITH beats AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_at,
    "RR_MILLIS" AS rr,
    SUM("RR_MILLIS") OVER (
      PARTITION BY timestamp_at
      ORDER BY "SEQ"                 -- bzw. "RR_MILLIS", falls SEQ kein Intra-Paket-Zähler
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS c
  FROM "HEART_RR_INTERVAL_SAMPLE"
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_at)
),
recon AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_at
      + ( ( c - ( MIN(c) OVER (PARTITION BY timestamp_at)
                + MAX(c) OVER (PARTITION BY timestamp_at) ) / 2.0 )
          * interval '1 millisecond' ) AS beat_ts,
    rr
  FROM beats
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(beat_ts, $__interval) AS "time",
  AVG(rr) AS "RR"
FROM recon
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(beat_ts, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 2000

SELECT timestamp_at, "STAGE"
FROM "XIAOMI_SLEEP_STAGE_SAMPLE"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_at)

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT s.wakeup_time_at AS timestamp_at, 6 AS "STAGE"  -- 5 = Awake
FROM "XIAOMI_SLEEP_TIME_SAMPLE" s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.wakeup_time_at)

ORDER BY timestamp_at
LIMIT 5000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval), AVG("B7B8_DOM") AS "Dominance", AVG("B7B8_OFF") AS "Interference" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) LIMIT 144000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval,0), AVG("HF_MS2") AS "HF", AVG("LF_MS2") AS "LF", AVG("VLF_MS2") AS "VLF", AVG("ULF1_MS2") AS "ULF1", AVG("ULF2_MS2") AS "ULF2", AVG("DFA_ALPHA1") AS "DFA" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval, 0) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval, 0) LIMIT 144000

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval), SUM("B7B8_DOM" + 0.5) AS "Sympathic Dominance Time under threshold" FROM "HRV_MINUTE_AGGREGATED" WHERE "B7B8_DOM" < -0.5 GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval)

SELECT date_trunc('day', s.wakeup_time_at) AS time,
       COUNT(*) AS Phases,
       to_char(s.wakeup_time_at, 'DD.MM.YY') AS tag
FROM "XIAOMI_SLEEP_STAGE_SAMPLE" stage
JOIN "XIAOMI_SLEEP_TIME_SAMPLE" s
  ON stage.timestamp_at >= s.timestamp_at
 AND stage.timestamp_at <= s.wakeup_time_at
 AND s.timestamp_at < '2026-01-01'::timestamp
GROUP BY 1,3
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', s.wakeup_time_at) AS time,
       COUNT(*) AS Deep
FROM "XIAOMI_SLEEP_STAGE_SAMPLE" stage
JOIN "XIAOMI_SLEEP_TIME_SAMPLE" s
  ON stage.timestamp_at >= s.timestamp_at
 AND stage.timestamp_at < s.wakeup_time_at
 AND s.timestamp_at < '2026-01-01'::timestamp
 AND stage."STAGE" = 2
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at,$__interval,0), AVG("N_BEATS") AS "HR", AVG("CIRC_24H") AS "CIRC24", AVG("CIRC_11H") AS "CIRC11", AVG("CIRC_6H") AS "CIRC6", AVG("CIRC_5H") AS "CIRC5", AVG("CIRC_4H") AS "CIRC4", AVG("ULF_22MIN") AS "ULF22", AVG("ULF_10MIN") AS "ULF10", AVG("ULF_8MIN") AS "ULF8", AVG("VLF_5MIN") AS "VLF5", AVG("VLF_4MIN") AS "VLF4", AVG("LF_MAYER_10S") AS "LF_MAYER", AVG("HF_BREATH_5S") AS "HF5", AVG("HF_BREATH_4S") AS "HF4", AVG("HF_BREATH_3S") AS "HF3", AVG("HF_BREATH_2S") AS "HF2" FROM "HRV_SPECTRAL_BANDS_MINUTE" WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_ms_at) GROUP BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval) ORDER BY $__timeGroup(timestamp_ms_at, $__interval)
